steps.title: Verify Eligibility & Developer Credentials
steps.action: Confirm the property lies within a designated freehold area and the developer is RERA-registered with a valid escrow account.
steps.why: Foreign ownership is only permitted in specific zones under Regulation No. (3) of 2006. Verification prevents legal complications and protects your investment.

steps.title: Secure with SPA & Oqood Registration
steps.action: Sign the Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA) and ensure your developer registers the sale on the Oqood system within 90 days.
steps.why: Oqood registration legally secures your interim ownership rights during construction. Without it, your contract lacks official DLD recognition.

steps.title: Register Title & Pay DLD Fees
steps.action: Complete the transfer at the DLD, paying the 4% transfer fee plus administrative costs (approx. AED 4,000 + VAT for properties over AED 500k) to receive your title deed.
steps.why: The title deed is your legal proof of ownership. Understanding total transaction costs (typically 7-10% above purchase price) prevents budget surprises.

steps.title: Maintain & Understand Ongoing Obligations
steps.action: Budget for annual dubai properties service charges (set by RERA's Mollak system) and understand your obligations under Dubai's jointly-owned property law.
steps.why: Service charges directly impact your net yield. Persistent non-payment can lead to legal enforcement, including potential court-ordered sale of the unit.
